g.text: More calibration labels do not ensure stability

g.text: 5% budget · blue: median and 5th–95th percentiles over 100 runs per repeated tier · hollow diamond: one full-pool run

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #546575

g.text: Repeated runs reuse development pools; bands are descriptive, not confidence intervals. These are not the locked final evaluations.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #546575

g.text: Columns use different omission and area scales. Chákṣu stabilizes within this design; RIGA remains variable.
